files.name: dochi_npc_core-0.1.1-fabric-1.21.1.jar
files.html:
0.1.1 Change Log

  • Added NPC head angle adjustment settings.
  • Added an option to make NPCs immune to damage.
  • Improved the UI structure.
  • Added Immersive Melodies integration as a DayCycle work activity for NPCs (Forge 1.20.1, NeoForge/Fabric 1.21.1).
